description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is well-trained and our environment is safe for all residents.

As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards. You will also lead our infection control initiatives, including surveillance, prevention strategies, and policy development, playing a key role in maintaining a healthy and safe environment.

This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. We are seeking a proactive and experienced professional ready to make a significant impact. Apply today to learn more about joining our compassionate team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development and/or infection control within a healthcare setting
Familiarity with state and federal healthcare regulations
